# Manifestoo Core

Source: https://github.com/acsone/manifestoo-core/blob/main/README.md

# Manifestoo Core

[![Github-CI][github-ci]][github-link]
[![Coverage Status][codecov-badge]][codecov-link]
[![PyPI][pypi-badge]][pypi-link]

<!--- shortdesc-begin -->

A library to reason about [Odoo](https://odoo.com) addons manifests.

<!--- shortdesc-end -->

## Installation

<!--- install-begin -->

```console
pip install manifestoo-core
```

<!--- install-end -->

## Features

<!--- features-begin -->

`manifestoo_core` provides the following features:

* Detect the Odoo series from an addon version.
* Information about core Odoo CE and EE addons for each Odoo version.
* Convert Odoo manifest metadata to Python Packaging Metadata.

Read the [documentation](https://manifestoo-core.readthedocs.io/) for more information.

```{warning}
Any part of the library that is not documented may change without notice.
```

<!--- features-end -->

# Development workflow

Source: https://github.com/acsone/manifestoo-core/blob/main/docs/develop.md

# Development workflow

## Linters

This project uses [pre-commit](https://pre-commit.com/) to check and apply various
linters.

Run `pre-commit install` in your local git clone to be sure to apply them locally before
pushing to GitHub.

## Running tests

To debug tests, install the project in a virtual environment using
`pip install -e .[test]`. You can then run tests using `pytest`.

You can also run all tests using `tox`.

## Creating a release

- Run `towncrier build --version {version}` to update `HISTORY.rst`.
- Run `tox -e docs` to update the API reference and verify that the documentation builds
  correctly.
- Commit and push.
- Make sure the tests pass on GitHub.
- Create a tag and release on GitHub and let the CI publish to PyPI
